prompt: A kitchen scene with an experienced chef wearing a white hat standing behind an old, worn wooden counter. The chef is holding a large knife and cutting carrots on a cutting board. A shiny, new red pot sits on top of a gas stove next to the counter; the pot is noticeably newer than the counter. A black cat is sitting under the counter facing the chef. On the counter, there are three apples and a group of carrots. The number of carrots is twice the number of apples. The three apples are arranged in front of the cutting board. Also on the counter are some onions, and their number is one less than the number of apples. A wooden spoon is inside the red pot. The chef is pointing at a recipe book that lies open between the apples and the cutting board. The recipe book is thicker than the cutting board. A kitchen towel hangs from a hook on the wall behind the stove. A salt shaker sits next to the recipe book on the counter.
